title: Quantum Computing
blurb: 27 units, maths first, from why amplitudes must be complex to Shor's algorithm and the threshold theorem, for a reader fluent in proofs, linear algebra and classical complexity who knows no physics; quantum mechanics is taught along the way, as far as the computing needs it.
needs: nothing installed — a browser and paper are the whole cost of entry; an optional NumPy simulator checks hand calculations
site_is: the whole course — decks, problem sheets, hint ladders and worked solutions
